title: Zenith Bank
description: A comprehensive full-stack online banking web application built with React and Flask, featuring secure session-based authentication, multi-account management, real-time transfers, scheduled payments, interactive Chart.js financial analytics, and client-side bank statement PDF export.
Highlights: Full-lifecycle banking and account management system featuring deposit, withdrawal, and fund transfer workflows with atomic MongoDB balance updates
Dynamic financial data visualization and reporting powered by Chart.js, with client-side PDF bank statement generation via jsPDF and html2canvas
Comprehensive transaction audit ledger with real-time multi-account filtering by date range, account ID, and transaction threshold
Automated payment scheduling and payee management engine supporting CRUD workflows and recurring payment records
Enterprise multi-pipeline CI/CD architecture leveraging GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines for automated testing (Pytest & Jest) and deployment to Azure App Service
